text: On the hillside above them, a herd of about two thousand pigs was feeding — remember, this was Gentile land; no Jewish town keeps pigs.
The spirits begged not to be sent out of the country, but into the herd.
In an instant the whole herd stampeded down the steep bank into the sea, and the water closed over them.
The men tending the pigs ran for town with the story of their lives.
